description: UK Power Networks, the distribution network operator for London, the East and the South East of England, runs an Opendatasoft portal with 138 datasets, read on 2026-09-26; its home page asks users to log in to view datasets and offers dashboards for curtailment, use of system charges, large demand and network operational data. Datasets read include half-hourly current and active power on named 132 kV and 33 kV circuits from 2021 to the previous month for the Eastern and South Eastern licence areas, named as in the Long Term Development Statement, with monthly summaries; grid and primary sites with coordinates, commissioning year, transformer counts, ratings and summer and winter demand; secondary substation supply areas traced from the customer connectivity model with headroom and predicted reinforcement year; the Embedded Capacity Register of generation, storage and flexible demand of 1 MW and above; the Optimise Prime commercial electric vehicle trial of over 8,000 vehicles; and the LTDS in Common Information Model format, first released in May 2026 under CGMES and IEC 61970. Most datasets are CC BY 4.0 and free; the CIM model uses a shared data licence. Caveats: some 33 kV circuits are redacted for privacy. Simulation uses are network flow model calibration, capacity planning and resilience studies. Related records: data-entsoe-cgmes-library documents the CGMES standard.
licence: CC-BY-4.0 for most datasets; LTDS CIM under the UK Power Networks Shared Data Licence
